featured.headline: Cops Are Using Flock to Spy on People for the Crime of Standing Around
featured.dek: Law enforcement agencies across the country are deploying Flock surveillance technology to monitor citizens engaged in no criminal activity, with bipartisan local governments enabling the expansion of the surveillance state.
